posts.title: GLM-5.1 in Real Coding Work
posts.description: Last year in July, I tasked Moonshot AI’s Kimi K2 and Claude Sonnet 4 with a real-world coding challenge: generating Swift DSP filters and a Python tool that generates Swift unit tests for them. Both models failed, stalling on tolerances and unhandled phase jumps. I care less about benchmarks than whether it actually works in practice; this test has some complexity, requiring iterative refinement

posts.title: Go, GPT, and the Trap of Sycophancy
posts.description: Go (Baduk/Weiqi) Go is a strategic game that originated in ancient China at least 2,500 years ago, and is still played today. Go rules are simple (see below), and the game is easy to pick up but incredibly difficult to master.
